name: ball_proximity_driving_toward_a_far_ball_pays_the_potential_gained
description: 1v1: blue starts 3000 uu from the resting ball at 1000 uu/s with the throttle off, for 20 steps (1.33 s). The car coasts and slows, so it closes less than 1333 uu: the sum is the potential gained minus the hold tax and lies between 0 and Phi(1667) - Phi(3000) = 0.196 for a constant-speed drive; measured 0.092 (about 900 uu closed, as a coasting car would). Closing pays positive.
